statement: Only the three public assets affected by the v1.7.1 OpenCode Go compact-label fix were refreshed and live in this folder. Every one is derived from the same synthetic demo data as the v1.7.0 artwork: invented quota percentages, balances and token totals only. No real account balances, API keys, account IDs, emails, private paths or personal usage appear, and every image carries the permanent SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA marker. The PNGs are offline renders of the unchanged production WPF views; quota.gif is a real screen capture of the packaged v1.7.1 preview window driven by the app's synthetic fixture. No desktop outside the application window is captured.
note: docs/media/v1.7.0/ is preserved byte-identically. Only the OpenCode Go monthly compact alert label changed ("月" -> "1mo"); the Expanded/Settings Chinese labels, thresholds, colours and all other UI behaviour are unchanged, so only assets that visibly showed the old label were regenerated.
